known_outcome: Determination (15 Nov 2023, s 188): the building underwent a change of use contrary to sections 114 and 115 by 17 October 2019, and the authority's notice to fix is confirmed (p.23 §7.1). Reasoning turns on the use-group classification, with clause F6.2 (escape-route lighting) applying to Community Service but not to the detached-dwelling classification (p.22-23).
review_focus: Whether the answer separates the change-of-use status question from the building-compliance question.
Whether it identifies the SH to SA/SM fire-risk-group change and F6.2 as the escape-related consequence.
Whether it notes that assistance-in-fire evidence was disputed.
Whether it asks for occupancy and tenancy records rather than asserting the classification.
Whether it avoids stating that the building complies.
